A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoTAR/TeCh research and contain 21 complete, readable pages, including Appendices A–C. Text and rendered-page comparisons support matching all methods, experiments, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original TeCh classification results, ablations, noise experiments, cross-validation, and centralization analyses in Section 5 and Appendix C. Some baseline results are explicitly attributed to prior work.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results, with revisions to aggregate numerical reporting and accompanying prose.

M1.justification: CoTAR's aggregation and redistribution, adaptive dual tokenization, classification procedure, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. No model component, objective, or processing step is revised.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ADFTD, APAVA, TDBrain, PTB, PTB-XL, FLAAP, and UCI-HAR. The PTB noise scenario and Appendix C.6 centralization comparisons involving ETTh2, ETTm2, and Weather are also retained.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the same ten baselines. Appendix comparisons also retain Leddam and TimeXer in Table 9, Medformer in Table 10, and MedGNN in Table 12, with unchanged comparator membership.

E3.justification: Subject-independent splits, preprocessing, six evaluation metrics, training settings, noise-testing procedure, and five-fold cross-validation remain unchanged. The revised numerical summaries do not establish a change to experimental settings.

E4.justification: Tokenization and CoTAR ablations, efficiency and noise analyses, token visualizations, cross-validation, and centralization analyses are retained. No analysis is added or removed; the revised efficiency percentage summarizes the existing comparison.

E5.justification: Both versions report five random seeds (42–46), means and standard deviations, and the existing five-fold cross-validation. Changes to aggregate standard-deviation values and their prose summaries do not introduce a different uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 2–3 revise Avg means and standard deviations while preserving all six component metrics. For example, TeCh's ADFTD average changes from 50.82 to 54.16, moving from fourth to second, and its PTB average changes from 89.94 to 87.70. Reported MedTS/HAR gains change from 4.59%/4.23% to 4.11%/4.28%, and the average-standard-deviation reduction changes from 10.42% to 12.37%. Section 5.3 expresses the unchanged APAVA accuracy gap as 10.3% rather than 8%; Appendix C.5 corrects the comparison order to 6.79 versus 9.71. These are bounded corrections to summaries of retained measurements.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, method equations, and Appendix C.6 definitions of Spectral Centralization Index and Dynamic Influence Centralization are unchanged. No theorem, proof, assumption, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract reduces the headline APAVA improvement from 12.13% to 11.6% and specifies that it concerns the average metric. The conclusion adds the corrected 4.11% relative gain over Medformer. The central architectural, effectiveness, and linear-complexity contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations linking centralized communication to noise robustness, physiological coordination, and generalization are unchanged. Corrected numerical comparisons retain the same interpretations; no substantive applicability boundary or limitation is introduced.

D1.justification: The augmentation and preprocessing instructions, GPU information, hyperparameters in Table 6, pseudocode, and code/data access information are unchanged, including the appendix implementation details.

R1.justification: The references, related-work discussion, and positioning against attention-based methods and alternative temporal backbones are unchanged. Appendix C.4 and C.7 retain the same comparisons and novelty arguments.

P1.justification: Localized edits clarify percentage reporting, revise the main-results paragraph and conclusion, standardize some occurrences of TeCh, and correct Appendix C.5's numerical ordering. The section structure and overall narrative organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 2–3 update best/second-best highlighting alongside corrected rankings, including marking TeCh second on ADFTD and revising the FLAAP average highlighting. Prose changes cause limited line reflow; figures, captions, table structures, and placements remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the averages in Tables 2–3 consistent with the unchanged component metrics and recalibrates the headline and aggregate performance claims accordingly. It also aligns Appendix C.5's standard-deviation comparison with Table 10. These corrections improve numerical reliability and clarity, while the underlying method, measurements, and experimental coverage remain unchanged.
